purpose: Field registry for the Domain / Clustering Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name only.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines row identity.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use the Layer 1 frozen family phrase, lightly normalized only when needed.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates Bayesian, graph, image-guided, topic-model, and integration-aware routes.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input object for this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level inputs, not callable parameters.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes expression-only, image-informed, reference-informed, multi-slice, and multi-omics branches.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role inside Domain / Clustering.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only spatial-domain or clustering use.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps cross-topic methods scoped to domain identification.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use domain labels, embeddings, topics, annotations, or aligned clusters as appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Clarifies whether the method returns direct domains or upstream representations.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision-level difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise branch-local distinction.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the decision tree.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement from the frozen registry.
fields.fill_rule: Use CPU, Optional GPU, Required GPU, or unclear; do not infer runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a resource gate only.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear; prefer unclear/medium when evidence is method-paper-local.
fields.topic_relevance: Flags large-image, graph, foundation-model, or multi-omics caution.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger slides, many spots, or multi-sample scale.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text or unclear; do not claim BioHarness validation.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps route large studies away from fragile first reads.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current public code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: available when frozen registry says Yes; unclear when Pending or absent.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage only.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official source link.
fields.fill_rule: Fill from frozen GitHub URL when present; otherwise unclear.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides traceability for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use method paper, benchmark/review, registry/local evidence, or mixed.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates direct evidence from review-derived inclusion.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note separating direct evidence from Layer 2 synthesis.
fields.fill_rule: Explicitly label direct registry/PubMed evidence and synthesized judgment.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents overclaiming selection fields as validated facts.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within the topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a conditional sentence; avoid default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds conditional decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Condition where this method should not be first read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents branch mismatch without runtime claims.

fields.name: Image Signal Use
fields.definition: Whether histology, morphology, or image-derived features drive domain selection.
fields.fill_rule: Use none apparent, histology/image-informed, or optional multimodal/image branch unclear.
fields.topic_relevance: Important because image-guided methods may be inappropriate when matched imaging is absent.

fields.name: Cross-slice / Batch Cue
fields.definition: Whether the method explicitly supports or plausibly targets multi-slice, multi-sample, alignment, or batch-aware domain comparison.
fields.fill_rule: Use explicit/plausible multi-slice branch or single-slice first/unclear.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates single-section domain calling from cross-section alignment/comparison.

fields.name: Spatial Prior
fields.definition: Dominant way spatial structure enters the model.
fields.fill_rule: Use concise descriptions such as graph, Bayesian, neighborhood kernel, image plus neighborhood, or spatial low-dimensional prior.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures the scientific assumption that creates domain smoothness, isodepth structure, or boundary behavior.

fields.name: Domain Output Granularity
fields.definition: Granularity of output expected for domain review.
fields.fill_rule: Use discrete labels, aligned labels, semantic annotations, topics/modules, or embeddings.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents treating every method as the same kind of cluster-label generator, especially when some rows return continuous topographic coordinates rather than only plain labels.

fields.name: Modality Integration Branch
fields.definition: Main modality branch used for selection.
fields.fill_rule: Use expression + coordinates, expression + image, spatial multi-omics, reference-informed, marker/semantic, or related branch.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local routing by available data modality.

fields.name: Benchmark Support Cue
fields.definition: How benchmark or review evidence appears in the frozen registry evidence.
fields.fill_rule: Use frozen registry source labels only; mark unclear when broad all-candidate support is absent.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps benchmark evidence local rather than converting it into a global ranking, which is especially important for newer branch-expanding rows such as topographic-gradient methods.
